blocked_components.name: Comp 1 emit
needs: compute gate_vec via bridge_forward (HUB_DIM=8, HIDDEN_DIM=64, D_MODEL=4096 matmul + tanh-gelu)
deterministic LCG random control branch (seed * 2654435761 + step * 40503)
emit JSONL line with 4096-element float array, step, seed, tension, phi
blocked_components.explanation: All 16 shards are byte-stream compressors. They cannot generate, project, or clamp float arrays. Only output they produce is compressed byte stream + (a25) byte-class statistics. Emitting 4096-d JSONL would still require the missing compiler to author the arithmetic & matmul logic. No exact / wrappable / chainable fit exists.

blocked_components.name: Comp 3 readback
needs: parse pod last-hidden JSONL (4096-d float vec per line)
L1 score: count of phi components with |v| in [0.05, 0.50]

candidates.rationale: a25 emits byte-class statistics (json_per100, text_per100, rule_density_per100). rule_density could *theoretically* be co-opted as a degraded L1-proxy if it tracked the gate-band membership of projected phi. Phase 4 pilot measured Pearson corr = -0.313 (weak negative, indistinguishable from noise) on 6 fixtures. NOT viable as a substitute.

blocked_components.explanation: Pilot wrap (a25 classify -> proxy L1) failed: corr -0.31. a25's byte-class statistics carry zero information about the random-projection-induced L1 score. No other shard exposes any numerical operation on the input bytes beyond compression.

blocked_components.name: Comp 4 orchestrator
needs: 5-seed result aggregation (active_l1_mean, active_l1_std, random_l1_mean, random_l1_std, etc.)
Z-score = (active_mean - random_mean) / sqrt((active_std^2 + random_std^2) / N + eps)
verdict tree: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL on (active_l1_mean >= 14, z >= 3) thresholds
blocked_components.explanation: Statistical aggregation across N runs is not a byte-compression operation. Even hxc_composite_chain (the closest 'orchestrator' shape) only chains compression stages; it has no float-array math, no statistics, no comparator logic. No fit.
